Bare urls in prose: see http://example.org/path, and https://example.org/other; also
(http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar)) keeps both parens but (http://example.org) does not.
A trailing sentence ends at http://example.org. Another ends with a question http://example.org?
An entity survives intact: http://example.org?x=1&amp;
A bracketed link is not double-linked: [http://example.org label] but the next one is bare: http://example.org
A url inside a wikilink target (unusual, but must not crash): [[http://example.org|odd]]

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center"
|+ Example table with a caption
! Name !! Born
|-
| [[Ada Lovelace|Ada]] || 1815
|-
! scope="row" | Total
| colspan="1" | n/a
|}

A table whose first row has no |- marker, immediate cells with a pipe-bearing wikilink:
{|
| [[Foo|Bar]] and '''bold''' and ''italic''
| plain
|}

Nested table inside a cell, with the inner table's own row/cell markers:
{|
| outer cell one
{|
! inner header
|-
| inner data with a bare url http://example.org/inner.
|}
more outer text
|-
| outer cell two
|}

An unclosed table degrades to plain text: {| class="x"
| unterminated
